description: Correct onboarding semantic drift and remove invented questionnaire fields not present in web implementation. Current mobile onboarding contains focus areas, capacity options, work start/end time, planning style, and first day objective that do not match web OnboardingService requirements. Web onboarding (lib/services/OnboardingService.ts) requires minimal setup: timezone detection and optional first plan activity generation. Mobile must match this minimal flow: Google Login → check onboarding state → minimal required setup → Today screen.
steps: Read web OnboardingService (lib/services/OnboardingService.ts) and identify actual required onboarding fields
Read web onboarding action/route to understand server contract
Compare against mobile OnboardingScreen.tsx (m/src/features/onboarding/OnboardingScreen.tsx) and OnboardingState type in m/src/api/types.ts
Remove unnecessary fields from mobile: focusAreas array expansion beyond web semantics, dailyCapacity if not server-required, planningStyle if invented, work start/end time if not canonical
Preserve only fields web actually stores and uses: timezone, firstDayObjective (if web uses it), completedAt
Update OnboardingScreen.tsx to reflect minimal web-matched UX: timezone detection, optional goal input, immediate completion
Update m/src/api/types.ts OnboardingState interface to match web contract exactly
Verify web onboarding completion creates default activities correctly and mobile replicates this via API
Remove any mobile-only questionnaire steps not present in web flow
acceptance_criteria: Mobile OnboardingState type matches web OnboardingService state shape exactly
Mobile onboarding screen collects only data web onboarding requires
No invented mobile-only questionnaire steps remain
Onboarding completion calls web API and receives same initial setup as web users
User reaches Today screen immediately after minimal setup, matching web behavior
verification: Visual inspection: OnboardingScreen.tsx contains no focus area selection, no capacity slider, no work hours, no planning style picker beyond what web uses
Compare OnboardingState fields in m/src/api/types.ts against lib/services/OnboardingService.ts DEFAULT_ONBOARDING_STATE
Test flow: Start onboarding → complete minimal setup → verify Today screen loads with same initial state as web new user
